gaps.title: GCI Engine Scalar Metric Hardcoded to CL (Aerodynamic Lift)
gaps.description: GciEngine.evaluateStrictContract is currently hardcoded to CL. For internal channel flow, symmetric bodies, or bluff shapes where CL is nominally 0.0, evaluating (f1 - f2) / max(|f1|, 1e-12) causes numerical degradation or artificial relative uncertainty explosions. GCI must accept generalized engineering scalars (total pressure drop deltaP, drag coefficient Cd, skin friction coefficient Cf).
gaps.rootCause: Initial GciEngine implementation was developed for aerodynamic airfoil benchmarks (e.g. NACA 0012) without generalized scalar selector.

gaps.title: Adaptive Orchestrator Bypasses Case-Specified Turbulence Scheme
gaps.description: AdaptiveIndustrialCFDEngine.runSimulation hardcodes turbulenceScheme: 'K_EPSILON', ignoring caseDef.turbulenceModelIdentity ('SST_K_OMEGA', 'LAMINAR', 'K_EPSILON') and caseDef.flowRegime ('LAMINAR'). Even though Fvm3DNavierStokesSolver supports SST k-omega and laminar flow, the orchestrator does not route them.
gaps.rootCause: Hardcoded config object in AdaptiveIndustrialCFDEngine lines 129-131.

gaps.title: Absence of Dynamic Pressure Inlet & Convective Outlet Boundaries
gaps.description: Fvm3DNavierStokesSolver supports INLET, OUTLET, WALL, and SYMMETRY. Advanced boundaries such as Stagnation/Total Pressure Inlet and Convective Outflow are not yet implemented in 3D FVM cell-face equations.
gaps.rootCause: Core FVM solver focused on standard Dirichlet velocity inlet and fixed pressure outlet.
gaps.notes: Standard INLET/OUTLET/WALL/SYMMETRY are fully sufficient for the declared qualification scope.

gaps.title: Global Momentum Balance Telemetry Decoupled from CFDEvidenceGenerator
gaps.description: Global mass balance is strictly verified (0.0000% error), but GlobalMomentumBalance diagnostics are not automatically sealed inside CFDEvidenceGenerator artifact JSON payload.
gaps.rootCause: Evidence schema priority was assigned to continuity and mass conservation in G1-E.

gaps.title: Compressible Solver Quarantined as Non-Discretized Experimental Prototype
gaps.description: CompressibleNavierStokesEngine uses 1D axial algebraic relations rather than conservative 3D FVM cell-face shock capturing. It is not integrated into AdaptiveIndustrialCFDEngine and must be strictly quarantined from production claims.
gaps.rootCause: Preliminary research prototype created prior to formal qualification.
gaps.notes: Formally declared NON_QUALIFIED in baseline; no production claims permitted.

gaps.title: Analytical Benchmark Suites Lack Automated End-to-End Pipeline Harness
gaps.description: PoiseuilleFlowBenchmark, LidDrivenCavityBenchmark, and ZpgFlatPlateBenchmark exist as standalone classes in src/engine/cfd3d/benchmarks/ but lack a unified automated execution runner tied to the qualification gate.
gaps.rootCause: Benchmarks were executed independently in earlier upgrade phases.
